content:
There’s a new version of Pocket Casts out for podcast listeners today, and it includes three new features. One in particular will be of interest to drivers with CarPlay.

A month ago, Pocket Casts shipped an update that included Liquid Glass design throughout the app. The update also added chapter artwork to the app’s mini player.

Today’s release gives even more attention to the mini player and podcast chapter artwork.

“The mini player got bigger controls (your thumbs asked nicely), and the bottom of the podcast grid eases into a blur, so nothing gets lost or hard to read where the grid meets the player,” according to the release notes.

In addition to the mini player changes, Pocket Casts version 8.15 includes three new features. First, folders now include context menus. Next, there’s a new Siri shortcut for marking the current episode of a podcast as played. And finally, chapter artwork now appears on the Lock Screen, in Control Center, and on CarPlay.

The update also drops support for two older versions of iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch software releases: iOS 16 and watchOS 9. That means Pocket Casts app updates now require iOS 17 and watchOS 10 or later.

Additionally, the app’s release notes mention these bug fixes:

  • The Share swipe action now dismisses automatically
  • Fix the Filters search header popping back when few episodes match
  • Fix incorrect section heading when opening an episode on the Apple Watch
  • Fix “Download All” on a season not warning before using cellular data
  • The Playlists tab uses consistent background in dark mode

You can download Pocket Casts from the App Store.
